description:
If you selected "Create Sample Data" during the setup wizard, your site has been populated with a sample church, people, families, donations, prayer requests, and more.

Take some time to explore the app and see how everything works. When you are ready to enter your own data, a System Manager can click Manage Sample Data to add or remove the sample records. Remove the sample data before you go live. It also removes every record you added yourself.
name: Sample Data
title: Sample Data
